reviews.review_text:
Tom
Manchester, United Kingdom1 contribution
1
Unreal
Sep 2026 • Couples
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolute gem of a spot in Vietnam!
Finding a 24-hour venue that hits the mark on food, drinks, and atmosphere is rare, but Poku absolutely nailed it.
We dropped in during Happy Hour and were blown away by the value—the cold beers were crisp and refreshing, and the cocktail menu was surprisingly creative and balanced (not watered down at all!).
The food was the real highlight, though. The fresh spring rolls were super light, packed with fresh herbs, and served with a killer dipping sauce. When we switched over to the Western menu, the comfort food hit every expectation—hearty, fresh, and perfectly cooked.
Whether you're starting your night out, looking for late-night food after a long day, or grabbing an early morning drink, Poku has incredible vibes, friendly staff, and great tunes around the clock. Will definitely be coming back every time I'm in town!
